description: Score a local business on three pillars, website (45 percent), Google reviews (30 percent) and Google Business Profile (25 percent), and return an overall 0 to 100 score, a letter grade, each pillar with its verdict, and the top fixes. The website pillar comes from a live scan when a website is given. Review and profile facts (rating, review count, phone, address, hours) are supplied by the caller from the user or from a public listing; this tool does not look them up. A pillar with no facts is marked unknown and left out of the overall score rather than scored as zero.

address.description: Street address shown on the listing.

details_read.description: True only when the full listing was read, including its hours and website link. Missing hours or a missing website are only scored when this is true.

emergency_service.description: True when the listing says it takes emergency or after-hours work.

hours.description: Published hours by day, for example {"Monday": "8 AM to 5 PM"}.

listing_seen.description: True when the Google Business Profile was actually looked at. Defaults to true when a rating, review count or Google Maps URL is given.

open_24_7.description: True when the listing says open 24 hours.

phone.description: Phone number shown on the listing.

source_urls.description: Where the listing facts came from, such as the Google Maps URL.

trade.description: The trade in snake case, for example plumbing, hvac, roofing, electrical, dental, restaurant.

website.description: The business website, if it has one. It is scanned live.

name: score_local_presence
title: Score local presence
